comments.dependencies: What building the site needs. The Pages workflow installs only these.
comments.@duckdb/duckdb-wasm-shell: The query surface. Released in lockstep with duckdb-wasm -- same version string, same day, out of the same monorepo -- so these two ranges move together and there is no skew to manage.
comments.xterm: For its stylesheet, which the shell package does not carry. Held at the major the shell depends on: @xterm/xterm superseded it and ships a different stylesheet for a different major.
comments.devDependencies: Only verify.mjs needs playwright, and CI never runs it -- it wants a live relay and a native server.
